title: WHO CRUSHED His Tiny Castle?!
description: A giant footprint destroys a meerkat's tiny sandcastle. The 'monster' is hiding a sweet secret. Original 42-second visual animal mystery.
hook: Frame 0: huge coconut-shell shoe crushes a tiny sandcastle; by 2.4s an impossible giant shadow raises the question of who did it.
script: A giant round foot smashes a meerkat's sandcastle. He follows notched footprints and hollow thuds toward a leaning date palm. A huge two-legged shadow appears monstrous, but red twine and bamboo hint at a disguise. When the figure slips while reaching for a date, the meerkat catches its stilt and discovers a tiny mouse walking in coconut-shell shoes. The mouse was trying to fetch a date for his elderly grandmother. The meerkat helps deliver it, forgives the accident and shares a hug. In the final half-second the coconut shoe lands in empty sand with the opening's identical thump, making a seamless loop.

character_bible.meerkat: Small sandy-gold meerkat with dark eye patches, bright amber eyes and a cobalt-blue neckerchief. Same size and proportions in every shot.
character_bible.mouse: Tiny warm-brown desert mouse, oversized round ears, lilac mini-backpack, one white eyebrow spot. Always smaller than meerkat.
character_bible.elder_mouse: Elderly silver-gray desert mouse with a sage-green knitted shawl, rounded glasses, slow gentle movements.
character_bible.machine: Exactly two hollow dark-brown coconut-shell shoes with a distinct crescent-shaped notch on the right sole, tied to two slim bamboo stilts with red twine; a low reed-and-clay disguise hood. Never a real giant creature.
character_bible.world: One sunlit amber desert oasis: meerkat's miniature sandcastle by a low mouse burrow, one leaning date palm, a single dune. Consistent geography, warm late-afternoon light, sand blowing right-to-left.
character_bible.style: Original premium stylized 3D animal animation, expressive eyes, tangible fur, readable silhouettes, smooth physical animation, no text, watermark, existing franchises, or copied characters.

rewatch_trigger: The crescent notch in the first giant footprint at 5.6s is the exact notch on the right coconut-shell shoe revealed at 30.4s; the elderly mouse is subtly visible in the burrow at 7s.
loop_bridge: At 41.5–42.0s an identical low macro shot of the notched coconut sole hitting sand, with the same hollow thump and sand burst as frame 0; this time the castle is safely out of frame.
editing_notes: 42s 9:16; no narration and no required subtitles. Every 1–3 seconds add meaningful action, visual or information change. Action-on-action cuts, J-cut hollow thump before shadow, match cut coconut sole in final 0.5s. Original or verifiably royalty-free foley and music only.
production_gate: Require at least 8 distinct coherent animated scenes, consistent characters and props, full 30–50s vertical MP4. No repeated 2-second clips, Pillow stickers, unlicensed assets, paid generation, automatic upgrade or low-quality uploads. If insufficient free generation capacity, preserve story only and skip render/upload.
